newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - Mogas, fuel weaker, gas oil hol.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - Mogas, fuel weaker, gas oil hol.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Wednesday, traders said.

High sulphur barge prices drifted lower after weaker afternoon crude knocked back early gains. High sulphur barges were traded at $86 a tonne fob ARA in early business with Flushing barges done at $85 a tonne.
Gasoline was softer in line with weaker crude, healthy supply and lack of buyers. Eurograde barges were done at $197, $196 and $198 throughout the day.
Heating oil barges were 50 cents weaker with April IPE +25 cents done. Gas oil cargoes were steady to a touch firmer in the case of diesel on the back of tight supplies.
